plainTranslation: Their Venus in your 12th house: a dreamy, almost secret love - tender, hidden, easy to romanticize. Sometimes an affair, sometimes a love that lives mostly in the imagination. Failure mode: keeping it hidden, or loving an ideal. Bring it into the light to see if it's real.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
note: Imported from approved project marquee synastry house overlay material. Source file was not copied into the repository.
